runners_data.name: Lequinto
runners_data.note: Veteran hold-up performer who needs a strong pace to be effective, faces tactical disadvantage with likely slow tempo
runners_data.comment: Kept on for second behind next-time-out winner at Wolverhampton last month; considered
runners_data.spotlight: Into the veteran stage now and it's a long time since his latest AW win but he made the frame over C&D two starts ago and kept on well for second behind a next-time-out winner at Wolverhampton (6f) on his most recent outing.

runners_data.name: Spendmore Lane
runners_data.note: Versatile prominent racer who can make running if needed, trainer's 0/13 record concerning but mare has winning form at this level
runners_data.comment: Two 5f AW wins this year but she's odds-on to get it wrong at the start & that's the worry

runners_data.name: Aleppo Pepper
runners_data.note: Lightly-raced prominent runner returning from long absence, only three career starts make her hard to assess reliably
runners_data.comment: One good run in Ireland in January 2025; can build on recent return but she needs to
runners_data.spotlight: One promising run in Ireland in January 2025; she was returning from 435 days when a modest third of five in a Southwell maiden 19 days ago; not solid now handicapping.

runners_data.name: Mick's Spirit
runners_data.note: Prolific course specialist and clear pace angle, 54 days since last run but has winning form fresh
runners_data.comment: Multiple C&D winner; may not have to work too hard to secure the lead; dangerous again
runners_data.spotlight: Prolific C&D winner, most recently when making all 54 days ago; a 3lb rise won't stop him if in the same form and he may not have to work too hard to lead; major player.

runners_data.name: Ancient State
runners_data.note: Classy hold-up performer with excellent recent form, needs genuine pace pressure to show best but has tactical speed if required
runners_data.comment: 3-3 over 5f; easy Class 6 win at Southwell last month; ceiling yet to be established
runners_data.spotlight: 3-3 over 5f, including here, and he took his form to a new level with a comfortable Southwell success last month; up 6lb and now tackles Class 5 company but his ceiling is yet to be established.

races.paceDynamic: Mick's Spirit is the sole confirmed early leader and prolific course winner, likely to dictate from the front without pressure. Spendmore Lane and Aleppo Pepper sit prominent but both have shown they can be held up if needed. Ancient State, Lequinto, and potentially Spendmore Lane will be tracking from mid-pack or held up, creating a scenario where the leader faces minimal early pressure. This sustainable pace setup heavily favors front-runners and prominently-raced horses who can stay close to Mick's Spirit, as the lack of pace pressure will make it difficult for hold-up horses to close ground in a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Mick's Spirit leads without serious challenge through halfway
scenarios.body: The pace becomes too slow for closers to make up ground, allowing the leader to kick clear in the final furlong. Front-runners and prominent racers dominate the finish as hold-up horses find insufficient pace to close.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Takeover
scenarios.trigger: If Spendmore Lane or Aleppo Pepper press Mick's Spirit from the 2f pole
scenarios.body: A moderate pace battle develops that suits horses racing prominently who can quicken off a true gallop. The slight increase in tempo helps but still favors those positioned close to the pace throughout.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely crawling and Ancient State finds racing room
scenarios.body: The hold-up brigade gets the perfect setup with an extremely slow tempo that allows time for a sustained finish. Ancient State's class edge becomes decisive in a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Mick's Spirit stops suddenly or loses action
scenarios.body: The race becomes a scramble with no true pace, creating chaos that can suit any running style. Form and class become more important than tactical positioning.

watchPoints.text: Mick's Spirit may be rusty after 54-day break and could stop quickly if not fully wound up for return
Spendmore Lane's running style may switch to leading if Mick's Spirit doesn't show early speed, creating different pace dynamics
Ancient State has tactical speed despite hold-up style and could sit closer if sensing slow pace development
Aleppo Pepper only has three career runs making her pace positioning and finishing kick unpredictable
Track the early fractions as any sub-standard sectionals will severely disadvantage the hold-up horses

races.paceDynamic: Merlier and Comprador will lead from the gates, with both confirmed front-runners likely to set a solid early gallop over this 6f trip. Behind them, prominent racers Rogue Messiah, Akabusi, and Bone Marra will track the leaders closely, while hold-up horses Eternal Solace, Alasrae, and Goldwork will need to find racing room in the final 2f. The pace should be honest but not excessive with just two genuine leaders, creating a rhythm that will suit horses who can position prominently and have a sustained kick rather than pure sprinters. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and those with tactical speed who can avoid getting shuffled back in a competitive 11-runner field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is solid but controlled, allowing prominent runners to stay in touch
scenarios.body: The leaders set it up perfectly for those tracking just behind, who can kick clear in the final furlong without needing a miracle run from the back. Rogue Messiah and Akabusi are ideally positioned to capitalize on their tactical speed.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Artists Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too strong early with Merlier and Comprador going at it
scenarios.body: The front-runners tie up in the final furlong, opening the door for closers with a turn of foot to sweep past tired leaders. Alasrae's recent C&D win and Eternal Solace's progressive form make them the prime beneficiaries.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders gets an uncontested lead or breaks clear early
scenarios.body: Merlier or Comprador gets first run and holds on grimly, with their early position proving decisive in a competitive finish. The lack of genuine early pace pressure allows the leader to dictate terms and resist late challenges.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go off too conservatively or one drops out early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 3f pole, suiting horses with pure finishing speed regardless of position. This chaotic finish could throw up a surprise winner from those who wouldn't normally get their chance in a truly-run race.

watchPoints.text: Merlier could set too strong an early pace if pressured hard by Comprador, compromising both leaders' chances
Bone Marra returning after 171-day break but has won fresh before so monitor market support closely
Alasrae and Akabusi finished close together at this C&D last time so their clash will be key to the outcome
Little Jaybee has shown a tendency to fade in the finish and may struggle at this longer 6f trip
Eternal Solace needs a strong pace to aim at given her hold-up style but has the class to win if it develops

races.paceDynamic: Mortubo and Dusk Damsel will likely lead early, with Calabrian Soldato also showing prominent tendencies despite recent fading issues. Enter Sandman and Luna Beaux, both hold-up specialists with recent good form, will be positioned towards the rear waiting to pounce. The moderate early pace should suit those that can finish, particularly given several front-runners (Sun Path, Saddle Up, Calabrian Soldato) have shown tendencies to fade in the closing stages. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can stay on when the early pace-setters tire.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses strike
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is moderate and the prominent horses fade as expected
scenarios.body: Enter Sandman and Luna Beaux will have perfect position to unleash late runs when Mortubo and Dusk Damsel weaken. The fading tendencies of several front-runners creates ideal conditions for closers with tactical speed.

races.paceDynamic: Liveinthelight appears the only natural front-runner in a field dominated by hold-up horses and debutants, creating an uncontested lead scenario. With Knights Charge and Master Dancer likely to press from prominent positions, the early pace should be sustainable rather than testing. The abundance of hold-up types (Knights Charge, Mr Bollinger, Leonato, Crimson Dawn) means the majority will be relying on late runs over this 1m2f trip. This race shape clearly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will ensue when multiple hold-up horses converge in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Liveinthelight gets an easy lead without early pressure from the debutants
scenarios.body: She can dictate fractions and prove hard to peg back, while the hold-up brigade get tangled up behind. The lack of early pace pressure allows front-runners to conserve energy for the finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Debutant Breakthrough
scenarios.trigger: If one of the Gosden/Menuisier newcomers shows immediate ability and racing maturity
scenarios.body: The superior breeding of Be Hopeful or Cyrano De Bergerac overcomes their inexperience in a weak maiden. Their trainers' 14-day records suggest they're sending them here with confidence.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and Knights Charge gets the perfect late run
scenarios.body: His Kempton third showed he needs time to wind up, and a dawdling pace here would suit his hold-up style perfectly. The 148-day break could have him spot-on for Roger Varian.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Longshot
scenarios.trigger: If the front two in the market both disappoint and one of the outsiders benefits from the chaos
scenarios.body: A slow pace and subsequent sprint finish could see an unfancied hold-up horse like Leonato finally show improvement after his November debut. The weak nature of this maiden opens it up to surprises.

watchPoints.text: If Liveinthelight gets shuffled back early, the race becomes a lottery with no natural pace-setter
Watch for market support for Shopaholic and Be Hopeful as debut runners with limited public form
Knights Charge's position turning for home is crucial - needs to be within striking distance despite hold-up style
If the early pace is very slow, it could turn into a sprint finish favouring the unknown debutants
Master Dancer's jumping background might help him handle traffic problems better than pure Flat horses

runners_data.name: Joseph
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who won at course and distance last time and handles standard going well
runners_data.comment: C&D win, after being badly hampered early, in February; return to AW a plus; respected
runners_data.spotlight: Off the mark at the 16th attempt when overcoming adversity to win a C&D handicap in February; similar form when second at Kempton last month and subsequent turf flop easy enough to forgive (yet to show anything on grass); better expected back on AW and with Billy Loughnane booked.

runners_data.name: Hello Cotai
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 284 days off but has course form and proven over this trip
runners_data.comment: Returns to Britain on a dangerous mark but he has been absent for 284 days
runners_data.spotlight: Formerly trained by Adam West; two wins over 8.5f at Epsom in 2024; several good runs in France last year, including a 9.5f AW win at Chantilly; starts out for Jim Boyle on a feasible mark but he is eligible for weaker races than this one; absent 284 days.

runners_data.name: Romantic Spirit
runners_data.note: Front-runner drawn wide but has the pace to cross over and control from the front
runners_data.comment: 4-11 on AW and on a fair mark still; has the ability to feature despite wide draw
runners_data.spotlight: 4-11 on AW and only 1lb higher than for last October's front-running win at Southwell (1m3f); lower draw would have been ideal but she has the ability to feature.

runners_data.name: Criminal
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who was keeping on well last time despite traffic problems
runners_data.comment: Uninspiring formfigures this year but latest run was OK & he's down in class here; chance
runners_data.spotlight: Ten-race maiden and out of sorts so far this year; had little chance the way the race panned out in a 1m handicap here two weeks ago but he was keeping on well at the finish, boding well for today's return to 1m2f; drops in class too and he's of interest.

runners_data.name: Penfolds Grange
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse in good form after wind surgery with two recent runner-up efforts
runners_data.comment: Three good runs have followed wind surgery; should remain competitive
runners_data.spotlight: Had wind surgery in December and he has run three good races since, finishing fourth over C&D before two runner-up efforts at Kempton (1m); should remain competitive.

runners_data.name: Etretat
runners_data.note: Front-runner returning from 183-day break but has won twice at course and distance
runners_data.comment: C&D winner; returns from six months off on a dangerous mark; not discounted
runners_data.spotlight: Four AW wins, including C&D, and returns from a six-month break on a manageable mark; more good runs than bad at this track and he's not discounted.

runners_data.name: Onslow Gardens
runners_data.note: Hold-up maiden returning after 206 days but showed ability in defeat last year
runners_data.comment: Exposed 19-race maiden; on a fair mark but others appeal more for the win
runners_data.spotlight: 19-race maiden; ran some good races in defeat for this yard last year, including when last seen in October (1m2f, good to soft); withdrawn at the start having got upset in the stalls ahead of this month's intended return (10-1 at the time of withdrawal); others preferred for win purposes.

runners_data.name: Blue Wonder
runners_data.note: Prominent runner struggling in handicaps after decent novice form, needs to bounce back
runners_data.comment: Her novice/maiden runs were promising but she struggled in handicaps after; off 202 days
runners_data.spotlight: Recorded RPRs of 70 (twice) and 75 in her three novice/maiden runs last season; struggled badly in four handicap runs thereafter, dropping 9lb in the process; may bounce back at some point but she is risky back from a 202-day break.

runners_data.name: Lenny's Spirit
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse ridden by 5lb claimer who went desperately close over course and distance last time
runners_data.comment: Modest record on AW but he ran a cracker over C&D on last month's stable debut; key player
runners_data.spotlight: Just 1-28 on AW but he went desperately close to doubling that tally in an amateur rider's race over C&D last month, only headed in the dying strides (first run for Adam Kirby); 2lb higher today; one to consider with new headgear tried.

runners_data.name: Voix De Bocelli
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from hurdles with disappointing recent flat form
runners_data.comment: Below par on Flat/over hurdles on his last two starts; this winter's best came over 1m4f
runners_data.spotlight: Well beaten over hurdles three weeks ago and that followed a disappointing run at Kempton; his earlier AW form brings him into the reckoning but that was over further; others appeal more.

races.paceDynamic: Romantic Spirit and Etretat are the confirmed front-runners who will contest the early lead, with Romantic Spirit having shown consistent front-running form and Etretat returning from a break with four AW wins including course and distance. The presence of four prominent runners (Joseph, Criminal, Blue Wonder, Voix De Bocelli) creates congestion behind the leaders, setting up potential traffic problems approaching the home turn. This honest gallop over 1m2f will stretch the field out gradually, but the prominent brigade faces tactical difficulties if bunched up. The race shape clearly favours hold-up horses who can avoid the early scrimmaging and benefit from the strong pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Benefit
scenarios.trigger: If the two leaders set honest fractions and the prominent quartet gets shuffled back
scenarios.body: The strong pace stretches the field and creates gaps for closers to exploit in the final two furlongs. Hello Cotai, Penfolds Grange and Lenny's Spirit can time their runs perfectly from off the pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders gets an uncontested or soft lead while rivals compromise each other
scenarios.body: Romantic Spirit or Etretat can dictate terms and kick clear when the pace lifts, holding on from the closers. The winner comes from setting their own fractions without pressure.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the front two go too fast early and the prominent horses get good positions without interference
scenarios.body: The pace collapses in the final furlong allowing Joseph, Criminal or Blue Wonder to pick up the pieces. These runners benefit from a strong gallop but avoid the early speed duel.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Tactical Affair
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders are slowly away or get headed early creating a stop-start gallop
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the home turn with no strong pace to suit anyone. The best horse on the day wins regardless of tactics in a bunched finish.

watchPoints.text: Watch for traffic problems involving Joseph, Criminal, Blue Wonder and Voix De Bocelli if they all want prominent positions behind the leaders
Monitor whether Romantic Spirit can cross from her wide draw to take up the running without using too much energy
Hello Cotai and Etretat both return from long breaks so watch for any signs of rustiness in the preliminaries
Check if both Romantic Spirit and Etretat go forward together as a genuine speed duel could set this up perfectly for closers
Lenny's Spirit carries a 5lb claiming rider which could prove significant in a tight finish given his recent near-miss

races.name: attheraces.com/marketmovers Handicap

runners_data.name: Bennyworth
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who should find handicaps more suitable after gelding, though 66 days off and inexperienced apprentice jockey add question marks.
runners_data.comment: Some promise in qualifying runs; gelded since latest; opening mark doesn't look generous
runners_data.spotlight: Ran well for a long way on second and final start for James Owen (6f, AW) but always behind  over C&D on yard debut; gelded since; handicaps should offer more scope but his opening mark doesn't look overly generous.

runners_data.name: Katalyst
runners_data.note: Front runner with clear tactical advantage in this field composition, though 130 days layoff and unfamiliarity with the mile trip create some doubt.
runners_data.comment: Worth another go at 1m but overall form suggests improvement needed off current mark
runners_data.spotlight: Best efforts over 7f elsewhere but she didn't look as if the 1m trip was beyond her when fifth of nine on handicap debut at Southwell in December; overall form suggests improvement needed for the return to Polytrack.

runners_data.name: Timely Salute
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with concerning form over 1m distances and tendency to fade, though trainer William Knight in decent recent form.
runners_data.comment: Pedigree suggests he may need further than 1m but market can guide on handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Fair 7f debut on Chelmsford AW but never involved in two 1m starts after, most recently in a  Yarmouth novice 17 days ago; his pedigree suggests that trips beyond 1m may be ideal but still a likely type for handicaps and the betting can guide.

runners_data.name: Wild Thoughts
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner in excellent recent form with a win 8 days ago, perfectly suited to this race shape with Saffie Osborne's tactical awareness.

runners_data.name: Labiche
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 244 days off with known fading issues, though Henry Candy horses often improve for breaks.

runners_data.name: Betty Lemon
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with limited ability and 160-day absence, now fitted with hood after disappointing handicap efforts.
runners_data.comment: Minor 2yo form, including in 1m handicaps; has plenty to find on return; hood added
runners_data.spotlight: Minor 2yo form, finding nothing new when switched to handicaps (1m; turf and AW) in the autumn and has plenty to find on her return; hood added.

races.paceDynamic: Katalyst will be the only confirmed front runner in this small field, giving her a sustainable lead without early pressure from flag to finish. Labiche may press from a prominent position but has shown fading tendencies, while the majority - Bennyworth, Wild Thoughts, Timely Salute, and Betty Lemon - will sit back and look to finish. With one uncontested leader and four hold-up horses, this creates a moderate pace that will accelerate late as the closers make their moves. This race shape clearly favours the front runner who can control the tempo and the strongest closer who can produce the best late kick.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Katalyst gets an easy lead and stays the trip
scenarios.body: The mare controls fractions without pressure and has enough left to resist late challengers, making her best efforts over 7f suggest the mile won't be beyond her scope. Her front-running style becomes a significant tactical advantage in this small, closer-heavy field.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strongest Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow for Katalyst to sustain her kick
scenarios.body: Wild Thoughts or Bennyworth produce the best late turn of foot from their hold-up positions, with Wild Thoughts having winning form and Bennyworth offering more scope in handicaps. The moderate early pace sets up perfectly for horses with a strong finishing kick.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Takes Advantage
scenarios.trigger: If Labiche avoids her usual fade and stays closer to the pace
scenarios.body: The Henry Candy runner uses her prominent position to strike before the hold-up horses can get organized, though her tendency to fade late remains a significant concern. Her fresher legs after 244 days off could provide the necessary improvement.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Katalyst goes too slowly and multiple closers finish strongly
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy sprint finish where any of the hold-up horses can prevail, with Timely Salute potentially benefiting from the stronger pace despite distance concerns. This creates the most unpredictable outcome with the weakest horses capable of placing.

watchPoints.text: Katalyst's early fractions - if she goes too fast early she'll be vulnerable to late closers despite her tactical advantage.
Wild Thoughts' position turning for home - if she gets a clear run from her hold-up style she looks the main danger.
Labiche's effort pattern - watch if she can sustain her run better than usual after the long break.
Bennyworth's progress under the inexperienced apprentice - any market support would suggest stable confidence.
The pace through the first half-mile - if it's crawling, expect a bunched finish favouring the strongest closer.
